versions.changelog:
xiaohongshu-topic-analysis 0.1.0 (initial release)

- Provides structured analysis of Xiaohongshu (小红书) topics, posts, comments, and influencer activity for content planning and market research.
- Supports keyword/topic search, note detail retrieval, comment extraction, and creator content monitoring.
- Secure and API-based: No account login required; uses an authenticated API token.
- Designed for content strategists, market analysts, and creators needing efficient and in-depth data gathering.
- Usable on multiple platforms (WorkBuddy, Openclaw, etc.) and ready for integration into agent workflows.
